versions.content: pncSynchronousWakeup is set to FALSE and at least one explicitWakeupPnc reference If CommunicationConnector.cre- ateEcuWakeupSource is set to TRUE, EcuInstance.pncSynchronousWakeup is set to FALSE and at least one CommunicationConnector.explicitWakeup- Pnc reference is defined, then a dedicated wakeup source for this Communication- Connector is derived and that wakeup source wakes exactly those PNCs that are referenced by CommunicationConnector.explicitWakeupPnc . The CommunicationConnector is assigned to this wakeup source.
